entry.title: V3.7 Wuthering Waves Battle Rush
entry.content:
Dear Rovers,

The Wuthering Waves Battle Rush is now live! Record and share your most exciting battle moments with the hashtags #WutheringWaves and #WuwaBattle on X (Twitter)/YouTube Shorts/TikTok to compete for a reward of Astrite x2,000 and a chance to get featured on our social media with direct credits! Other than these rewards, 10 extra winners will be selected to receive a $50 Amazon Gift Card.

Showcase your outstanding battle tactics in a condensed clip and share them with us!

Content Requirement

Create your own combat video featuring Wuthering Waves.

We require no limits to the characters, level, or scenes. All entries that feature your combat in Wuthering Waves are qualified to join the event and compete for rewards!

How to Submit

Post your work on X (Twitter)/YouTube Shorts/TikTok with both hashtags #WutheringWaves and #WuwaBattle included publicly.

Submission Period

2026/09/30 - 2026/10/28 (PT)

Judging Criteria

All eligible works will undergo evaluation based on their adherence to the theme, degree of completion, reception among players, and other relevant factors.

Notes

To qualify for participation, you should include both hashtags #WutheringWaves and #WuwaBattle in your post.

Deleted posts will not be qualified for entitlement of rewards.

You can submit multiple entries. However, the same work published on different platforms will not count towards the rewards.

Entries listed below may be excluded from the judging process:

  • Works not created in accordance with Wuthering Waves

  • Works found to contain plagiarism or infringement of intellectual property rights

  • Works submitted outside the event period

  • Works created with the assistance of AI technology

  • Works featuring extremely aggressive content, including but not limited to themes of pornography, violence, politics, or racism

  • Works that have already been used for commercial purposes

  • Works deemed inappropriate by the judges

Failure to reply to the official staff within 7 days from the date of notification will be considered a waiver of entitlement to the rewards.

This event is open to submissions from all languages, as creators proficient in any language are eligible to compete for rewards. Entries differing only in language will be treated as equivalent works.

entry.title: Patch Notes for Wuthering Waves Version 3.7: Prism's Illusion, Heart's Illumination
entry.content:
Dear Rovers,

Thank you for your continued support. The following is a summary of content that will become available in Version 3.7: Prism's Illusion, Heart's Illumination.

[Maintenance Time & Compensation Details]

✦Maintenance Time: 2026-09-30 04:00 - 2026-09-30 11:00 (UTC+8)

✦Maintenance Compensation: Astrite x300, Crystal Solvent x2

✦Compensation Eligibility: Create a character and unlock the Mail feature before 2026-09-30 04:00 (UTC+8). The compensation will remain claimable until the next version update.

In the event that the maintenance is extended, the dev team will issue a follow-up notice and adjust the compensation accordingly.

✦Bug Fixes: Compensation Astrite x300

✦Compensation Eligibility: Create a character and unlock the Mail feature before 2026-09-30 04:00 (UTC+8). The compensation will remain claimable until the next version update.

[Version Update Details]

New Resonators

5-Star Resonator: Hsin (Electro/Rectifier)

Sentinel Hsin, guide of Mengzhou's civilization. Deeply emotional and fond of worldly joys, She has long kept the fires of mortal life burning amid the bustle of trade and the shifting of seasons.

Combat Roles: Main Damage Dealer, Coordinated Attack, Resonance Skill DMG, Unison, Electro Flare

Obtainable through the [As Full as Tonight, Forever] Featured Resonator Convene.

5-Star Resonator: Suoming (Electro/Sword)

Born in Huating, Mengzhou, she founded the Ten Seals Covenant as its Seal Master to liberate her homeland from the Evil Miasma. Later, by the Sentinel's decree, she served as Intendant of the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs, watching over all of Mengzhou.

Combat Roles: Concerto Efficiency, Basic Attack DMG, Unison, Electro DMG Amplification, Resonance Skill DMG Amplification

Obtainable through the [Nine Deaths, One Unbent Heart] Featured Resonator Convene.

New Weapons

5-Star Weapon: Blooming Jadehaven (Rectifier)

Jade to pillars, gold to nexus, a hundred mechanisms meshed into one working. Infinite forms divide and proliferate among the blooms, and it still fits in the palm of Her hand.

Walls and mechanisms know no feeling. What makes a life's work worth the life is not the making, but that something in it was loved.

Obtainable through the [Blooming Jadehaven] Featured Weapon Convene.

5-Star Weapon: Unspoken Rue (Sword)

With this canopy, she sheltered all life and sealed the Evil Miasma.

The Blight Rain ceased, the Miasmic Thunder fell silent, and a deep darkness lies trapped upon the canopy's surface.

Beneath it linger the shadows of no return, always walking by her side.

Obtainable through the [Unspoken Rue] Featured Weapon Convene.

New Area

Simulacrum Nexus of Mengzhou

Area includes: Heartscape Labyrinth, Heart of Flames, Heart of Frost, Heart of Bloom, Heart of Stillness, Heart of Ruin, Heart of Appearance

Xuanfang Hold's control mainframe, otherwise known as the Manifold Sanctum, governing the foundational order that keeps the city running.

Reach the location during Main Quest Chapter IV Act IV "Simulacrum of the Heartt."

New Echoes

Formrender, Soulfrayer, Skywatch Lancer, Bloomburst Puppet, Jade Nether Serpent and one new COST 4 Echo

**

New Sonata Effects: Heart of Sworn Vigil (5pcs Set), Flash of Electric Reflection (5pcs Set), Flower of Tinged Yearning (5pcs Set)**

Heart of Sworn Vigil (5pcs Set): Inflicting Electro Flare on the target, obtaining Unison, or triggering Unison Response increases the Resonator's Crit. Rate by 15% and grants them 22.5% Electro DMG for 30s.

Flash of Electric Reflection (5pcs Set): When the Resonator inflicts Electro Flare on enemies, they gain the following effects: Gain 10% Electro DMG Bonus for 15s. While this effect is active, casting Outro Skill grants the incoming Resonator 25% Electro DMG Bonus for 15s.

Flower of Tinged Yearning (5pcs Set): Healing a Resonator in the team increases the ATK of all Resonators in the team by 10% for 30s. Effects of the same name do not stack. While the effect is active, if the Resonator gains Unison effect or triggers Unison Response, their ATK is further increased by 15%.

**

New Tacet Fields: Heart of Stillness Tacet Field, Heart of Flames Tacet Field**

**

New Tacet Discord Nest: Simulacrum Nexus Tacet Discord Nest**

New Stories

[Main Quest] Chapter IV Act IV: Simulacrum of the Heart

The Waking Moon Festival is drawing near in the Land of Xuanfang, yet rumors that "the Hold is doomed to fall" have begun to spread through the city. To uncover the cause—and to find Hsin, who has not shown Herself for a long time—you enter the Simulacrum Nexus deep within the Sanctum, together with Suoming, an Intendant who claims to have been sent by the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs in search of Hsin the Moon Fox.

  • Duration: Permanently available after Version 3.7 update.

  • Eligibility: Complete Main Quest Chapter IV Segue "The Nethermancer's Requiem" to unlock.

New Quest Type

Tales Quest: Moonlike Heart, Mortal Longing

A mysterious girl approaches you on WavesLine, asking for your help to collect the scattered Feeling Capsule Shards.

  • Duration: Permanently available after Version 3.7 update.

  • Eligibility: Complete Main Quest Chapter IV Act IV "Simulacrum of the Heart."

New Events & Gameplay Features

[Special Events] [Cubie Wars] Leisure Event

With Encore's help, the Second Coming of Solaris has built a Wooly Stage for the Cubie Wars. On this stage, the Cubie Warriors will make use of magical items to wage a fierce battle!

  • Duration: Version 3.7 Update - 2026-11-11 11:59 (server time)

[Dreams in the Capsule] Area Exploration Event

Here Mengzhou's mountains and rivers, its woods and wilds, meet its pavilions and towers, the very place the people of Mengzhou, bound to one another across time, make their homes and live out their lives. Peace and quiet, ardor and flame, despondency and sorrow, every feeling there is settles into a Heart Realm of its own, continuing without end. In this small world, the Court of Savantae and Hsin are shaping the face of Mengzhou anew.

This is the Simulacrum Nexus.

  • Duration: Version 3.7 Update - 2026-11-11 03:59 (server time)

[Past Dreams, Traced Seals] Photo Collection Event

Hsin has arranged a task for Suoming, asking you to join her in recording the sights of the Simulacrum Nexus of Mengzhou.

A trip "down memory lane" that draws out the long-sealed memories of the Ten Seals Covenant…

  • Duration: Permanently available after Version 3.7 update.

[Artisan's Search] Featured Combat Event

Lisha, apprentice Artisan, reporting for duty!

  • Duration: 2026-10-08 04:00 - 2026-10-26 03:59 (server time)

[Echo Erase] Leisure Event

The latest flagship offering from Second Coming of Solaris! Come experience the fun of tapping Echo Pieces away!

  • Duration: 2026-10-22 10:00 - 2026-11-09 03:59 (server time)

[Beyond the Waves: Land of Xuanfang] Featured Exploration Event

During the event, you can complete event tasks once per day to obtain a set number of Adventure Logs. Each Adventure Log can be exchanged for an Adventure Package.

  • Duration: 2026-10-29 04:00 - 2026-11-11 03:59 (server time)

[Gifts of Waking Moon] 7-Day Login Event

During the event, log in to claim the day's login rewards from the event page.

  • Duration: Version 3.7 Update - 2026-11-11 03:59 (server time)

[Version Special Login Event]

[Gifts of Singing Drizzle] Limited-Time Login Event

After the event starts, log in to the game daily to add one day to your cumulative login days. Sign-in records refresh daily at 04:00 server time. Once your cumulative login days meet the requirement, the corresponding cumulative login reward will be ready to claim.

✦Duration: 2026-10-22 10:00 - 2026-11-11 03:59 (server time)

Rewards

[Log in for 1 day in total]: Radiant Tide x5, Premium Tuner x100

[Log in for 3 days in total]: Radiant Tide x5, Crystal Solvent x5

[Web Events]

[Waking Moon Fishing] Web Event

The Waking Moon Festival is underway. Lights shine everywhere. Then a mysterious stall appears right in front of you...

Participate in the fishing challenge and unlock entries in the Fishing Index to win Astrites! And complete event tasks to win Advanced Sealed Tubes and more.

  • Duration: 2026-10-15 10:00 - 2026-11-01 09:59 (UTC+8)

[Back to Solaris] Web Event

Invite your former companions back and complete tasks together to receive Astrites, Shell Credits, and more! Returning Rovers who link their accounts will also receive bonus gifts! With code linking rewards available for Returning Players!

  • Duration: Version 3.7 Update - 2026-11-11 23:59 (UTC+8)

[New Permanent Event]

Blooms for the Shadow

Looming over the Simulacrum Nexus of Mengzhou, the Nexus Fox Shadow watches the realm with cold detachment. Everything within the Heart Realms is born of Hsin's heart, and shifts as it does. This towering shadow, a manifestation of the heart, is bound up in that same interplay, shaping and shaped by the Heart Realms in turn.

However, a conversation with a Celestial from the Court of Savantae has revealed something new: the Fox Shadow reacts to a specific token within the Simulacrum Nexus...

  • Duration: Permanently available after Version 3.7 update.

New Merch

Accessories: Hsin - Spring in Bloom, Suoming - Glazed Roseate

WavesLine Looks: Light of Waking Moon (WavesLine Theme), Solicitude of the Heart (WavesLine Decor), Glow of Lanterns (Chat Background), Rice Cake (Chat Bubble)

The Moonlit Path event will be available in Version 3.7. During the event, obtain Moonlit Rings unlock the following new rewards.

Accessories: Hsin - Where Dreams Shine Clear, Rover - Not Even Close

Sigil: Not Even Close

Avatar: Abby Tossing

Motorbike Accessory: Hsin Cube

Collection Item: Cloudview Seat

Collection Items can be equipped on the Utility Wheel and used in the Overworld.

Other New Content

Sigils: Showtime, All Forms in One Heart

Avatar: Wooly's Blessing

Motorbike Livery: Fox Shadow at Sunset

Phantom Echo: Phantom: Skywatch Lancer, Phantom: Smolder

Sigil: Showtime and Avatar: Wooly's Blessing can be obtained by participating in the Leisure Event "Cubie Wars."

[Adjustments and Optimizations]

Features

**

Backpack:**

Optimized Echo Backpack Storage

  • All unequipped, non-upgraded Echoes in your Echo Backpack that share the same Echo type, Sonata Effect, and Mainstat will automatically stack into a single backpack item.

  • Each backpack item can hold up to 999 Echoes. The excess will be removed.

  • Adjusted the placement of the pieces of information displayed on Echo icons.

  • After Version 3.7 goes live, all your Echoes will automatically stack. Locked/Discarded Echoes that meet the stack requirements will stack according to the following rules.

  1. Locked Echoes and Non-locked Echoes will be marked "Locked" and stack together.

  2. Discarded Echoes and Unmarked Echoes will be marked "Discarded" and stack together.

  3. Locked Echoes and Discarded Echoes will be marked "Locked" and stack together.

**

Echo Recommendation**

Optimized Display of Echo Recommendation Screen

  • On the Suggest screen for Echo Recommendation, with Resonators who have two Resonance Modes, Resonance Mode-specific Echo sets will be recommended. If a popular set is the same as the default recommendation, the corresponding Resonance Mode icon will be displayed.

  • The above information will be synced to the Suggest menu for Echo Equipment.

**

Team**

Added Team Management

  • You can drag to reorder your teams via the Team Management menu.

  • You can also rename your teams. (The name of a team is displayed in the top left corner of the screen.)

  • The number of team setups has been increased to 20.

Added Lineup 3D Display

  • A 3D/2D button will appear in the top right corner of the Team screen, allowing you to switch between 3D and 2D display. (※2D is the default.)

  • Select the 3D option to display your Resonators in 3D mode.

  • Added the Preset Teams menu to the lineup page for Tower of Adversity, allowing you to select one of the Preset Teams for a challenge.

  • 3D Display is not available on devices with the following configurations:

  1. iOS:

RAM≤ 4GB

  1. Android:

RAM≤ 6GB.

Enabling 3D Display may contribute to the device load. Please choose the suitable option based on the performance of your device.

The current 3D Display feature is not the final version. We will continue to refine this feature in further versions in terms of visuals and device load.

**

Camera Mode:**

Improved Functionality & Usability

  • New UI, with the previously available features intact.

  • Added more shooting modes and adjustable parameters.

New Shooting Modes

  • Handheld mode, allowing you to adjust the character's line of sight.

  • Selfie mode, allowing you to take photos of Rover in various poses and expressions. (※Only Rover is available in Selfie mode.)

  • Added a drone view to the original shooting mode, allowing you to capture expansive panoramic views from great distances.

New Supportive Features

  • Added reference lines, allowing you to better frame and adjust shots.

  • Added lens templates, allowing you to select among the preset lens templates.

  • Added Quick Focus, allowing you to focus the camera on your subject by clicking on it. After using Quick Focus, you can adjust the Focus Distance with your subject as a reference.

Added On-character Lighting Templates

  • Select lighting templates to adjust the lighting effects on the current Resonator. You may adjust the Lighting Direction.

We will continue to refine the on-character lighting parameters and bring you more options in this regard. Please stay tuned.

Added Environmental Settings

  • You can adjust environmental settings such as Time, Weather, and Foliage Wind Direction in the Environment tab. (Changes to Time may take some time to take effect.)

  • Added the Atmosphere effect option. You can adjust the effect density.

  • With the Foliage Wind Direction option, you can adjust the wind direction, along with the wind strength. The wind direction and strength will affect how the foliage and the Atmosphere objects move.

  • The Environmental Settings apply only to Camera mode.

Added Preset Frames

  • You can add a preset frame to the photo you are taking.

  • Added the selectable "Wuthering Waves" logo to the photo you are taking (the size of the logo is adjustable.)

Optimized Global Filter Settings

  • In addition to the preset Filters in camera mode, there are also an adjustable Color Palette and other adjustable advanced parameters.

  • The Global Filter settings in Camera mode do not affect the Global Filter settings for and the display of the Overworld.

Leveling

**

Synthesis:**

Added One-Way Conversion

  • Access this feature via Synthesis > Conversion > One-Way Conversion

  • Added a method of obtaining Regenerative Pistils (Bioprinting material). You can convert collectible Resonator Ascension materials found within Jinzhou, Black Shores, Rinascita, Roya Frostlands, and Mengzhou, via One-Way Conversion, into Regenerative Pistils.

Challenges, Puzzles, & Events

**

Weekly Activity:**

Partially Adjusted Gameplay of "Fantasies of the Thousand Gateways"

  • Added Sigils associated with Flashburn (Fusion Burst) and Frostbane (Glacio Chafe).

  • Added gameplay content associated with Metaphors and Shop Items.

  • Optimized the mechanics of how Popular Teams recommendations are made in Tower of Adversity.

**

Quests**

**

Journey Log:**

Added Main Quest Replay Mode

  • After Version 3.7 is released, you can replay the Main Quests of Version 1.1: Thaw of Eons, Version 1.2: In the Turquoise Moonglow, and Version 1.3: To the Shore's End.

  • If you've already completed the above-mentioned Main Quests, go to Quests > Journey Log. To enter Replay Mode, press "Replay" on any of the Main Quests available for Replay. ※(To unlock Version 1.2: In the Turquoise Moonglow in Replay Mode, complete the Main Quest of Version 1.1 first.)

  • Your progress is automatically saved when you exit Replay Mode. You can resume from where you left off in the Journey Log, or reset your progress manually.

Some Main Quest-exclusive Trophies can be obtained through Replay Mode, but Items obtained during Replay Mode only exist there and won't carry over.

We will continue to refine the Journey Log feature and include more Quests in Replay Mode. Please stay tuned.

  • Optimized the quest flow and instructions of the Daily Quest "Short Days, Shorter Nights" and increased its daily reset frequency.

UI

  • Added a display of reward collection progress for certain gameplay features available in the Simulacrum Nexus of Mengzhou. When you're experiencing a specific gameplay feature, press the icon that appears next to the mini map in the top left corner of the screen to view your reward collection progress for the gameplay feature.

  • Adjusted the information that is displayed upon pressing certain icons on the map. When icons associated with certain gameplay features available in the Simulacrum Nexus of Mengzhou are selected, the displayed information will now include your reward collection progress.

  • Optimized the display of certain icons.

Graphics & Performance

**

Graphics Settings**

Extended Availability of Vulkan on Mobile

Following the Version 3.7 update maintenance, the Vulkan option can also be enabled on the following processors:

  1. Kirin Series: Kirin 8000, Kirin 8000A

  2. Dimensity Series: Dimensity 7200, Dimensity 7200-Ultra, Dimensity 8000, Dimensity 8100, Dimensity 8100-MAX, Dimensity 8200, Dimensity 8200-Ultimate, Dimensity 8200-Ultra, Dimensity 8250 Star Speed Edition, Dimensity 7300, Dimensity 7300-Ultra, Dimensity 8300-Ultra, Dimensity 8350, Dimensity 7500

  3. Exynos Series: Exynos 1480

  • This option is accessible via Settings > Graphics > Vulkan. Please restart the game after enabling the Vulkan option for the change to take effect.

  • Enabling the Vulkan option improves the game's performance and power consumption while it is being run on mobile.

Additionally, the Vulkan option will now be on by default on mobile devices equipped with Exynos 2600, Exynos 2500, Exynos 2400, Exynos 2200, or Exynos 1480, for better performance.

Extended Availability of Self-developed Frame Generation on Mobile

  • Extended support for self-developed frame generation to mobile devices equipped with Dimensity 9300 and Dimensity 9300+. If your processor meets the requirements, you can enable this option via Settings > Graphics > Frame Generation after enabling Vulkan.

  • Running the game with the "Frame Generation" option enabled at 60FPS (maximum) consumes less power than running the game at 60FPS without the option enabled.

Audio

  • Optimized some audio/stereo effects.

Other

  • Optimized instructional text that appears while driving the motorbike in certain scenarios.

  • Optimized the descriptions of certain in-game settings and functions.

Online Testing

**

Limited Test**

Tiered Client Resource Downloads

  • Tiered Client Resource Downloads is a feature that allows you to select between different resource tiers. In future versions of Wuthering Waves, the original single resource package will be divided into three tiers based on differences in graphics quality, models, and other game assets: UHD, HD, and SD. You may select and download the tier that best suits the storage space and device specifications of your device.

  • Test Participants and Test Schedule:

  1. PC (※Official Launcher): The test will become available in stages on PC after the Version 3.7 update.

  2. iOS/Android Mobile: The test will become available on all iOS/Android mobile devices after the Version 3.7 update.

The test schedule may be subject to change due to version stability or other considerations. Please refer to the announcement titled "About Tiered Client Resource Downloads" for more information about the test, available features, and FAQ.

This feature is at the testing stage and is not the final version.

**

Full-scale Test**

"New Programming Language" Cross-Platform Performance Optimization

  • We have conducted several rounds of testing for the "New Programming Language" performance optimization in Version 3.6 and have verified its stability. The limited test phase ended on 2026-09-09 at 15:00 (UTC+8). This optimization is now available to all players across all platforms.

  • On devices that meet the requirements across all platforms, the game's overall performance and average frame rate will improve to a certain extent.

  • This optimization is currently unavailable on the following devices (on these devices, the game client will continue to run in the original programming language, and the gaming experience will not be affected):

  1. iOS mobile: RAM ≤ 4GB; iPhone 14 series with iOS 16.0/17.0/17.1/17.2.

  2. Android mobile: RAM≤ 6GB.

This optimization is at the testing stage and is not the final version. The requirements regarding device specifications and the overall performance may be subject to change.

[Bug Fixes]

**

Resonators & Weapons**

  • Fixed an issue where Resonator Qingxiao's character model sometimes behaved abnormally while in the "Ephemeral Transcendence" state.

  • Fixed an issue where a number appeared on certain Skill icons while Resonator Qingxiao was in the "Sword Flight" state to show the remaining attempts of the Skill.

  • Fixed an issue where Resonator Qingxiao might move outside the bounds of the Map upon casting Sword Step.

  • Fixed a clipping issue with Resonator Qingxiao's character model displayed on the Resonators page.

  • Fixed an issue where Plume Step might not be triggered at the right time while Resonator Suisui was in the "Roaming Transcendent" state.

  • Fixed an issue where Resonator Chisa's character model behaved abnormally on some mobile devices when she made certain movements while wearing the Outfit "Peach Parfait."

  • Fixed an issue with the movements of Resonator Cartethyia in her Fleurdelys form while walking on water.

  • Fixed an issue that prevented Rover: Electro from interacting with the Hearthbear in the "Roya Frostlands - Frostlands Surface" area.

  • Fixed an issue where switching teams or weapons might prevent the buff "the ATK of all nearby Resonators in the team is increased" offered by the weapon "Firstlight's Herald" from taking effect.

**

Enemies & Echoes**

  • Fixed an issue where the effect "after casting the Echo Skill 'Thousand-Puppet Pavilion,' when the Resonator equipped with this Echo inflicts Havoc Bane, consume 1 Blade of Thousand Memories to deal Havoc DMG" could be triggered more than once every 1s.

**

Features**

  • Fixed an issue where the frame generation function might not work while in the "Huanglong - Mengzhou" area.

  • Fixed an issue where the screens of devices equipped with AMD Series graphics cards might flash with the frame generation option enabled.

  • Fixed an issue in the "Guidebook - Activity - Weekly - Phantasma Dreamland: Rhapsody" event where Echoes in the Chop Chop series might not be devoured first after the item "Unbeliever's Crown" was selected.

  • Fixed an issue that might cause a random prompt to pop up when claiming rewards on the "Guidebook - Activity" screen.

entry.title: About Tiered Client Resource Downloads
entry.content:
Dear Rovers, To deliver a higher-quality gaming experience across a wide range of device specifications, the "Tiered Client Resource Downloads" feature is scheduled to be launched soon on Wuthering Waves, initially as a limited test. This feature allows you to select and download game resources of your preferred graphics quality based on the storage space and specifications of your device. With this feature, you can reduce storage space usage while maintaining satisfactory graphics quality.

Feature Overview

What is Tiered Client Resource Downloads?

Tiered Client Resource Downloads is a feature that allows you to select between different resource tiers. In future versions of Wuthering Waves, the original single resource package will be divided into three tiers based on differences in graphics quality, models, and other game assets: UHD, HD, and SD. You may select and download the tier that best suits the storage space and specifications of your device.

This feature is designed to allow you to choose better graphics quality or lower storage space usage based on your actual gaming needs, thereby providing a better gaming experience.

Tier Specifications

Tiered Client Resource Downloads will be available for the PC, iOS, and Android versions of the game. The package tiers vary in in-game graphics quality, video bitrate, and other game assets. Supported platforms and tiers are outlined below:

| | | |

| --- | --- | --- |

| Platform | Available Tiers | Maximum Number of Local Packages |

| PC | UHD/HD/SD | Up to 3 packages (tiers) installed locally |

| iOS/Android | HD/SD | Up to 1 package (tier) installed locally |

Due to platform restrictions, platforms not listed above currently do not support resource tiering. Once this feature goes live, the HD package will be downloaded by default on those platforms.

Due to hardware limitations, only the SD package is available on certain mobile devices, in order to ensure a stable, smooth gaming experience. Please refer to your actual in-game experience.

Package Downloading & Switching

  • PC：

Download your desired tier or tiers directly from the launcher. You can install up to 3 different tiers locally and switch between them any time. If you have multiple tiers installed, to run the game, simply choose one tier from the launcher to launch (only one can run at a time). If you need to uninstall a specific tier, select the corresponding package before uninstalling.

  • iOS / Android:

Select your desired package tier from the in-game "Download Resources" menu. Once the download is complete, you can redownload and switch to another tier via Settings > Graphics > Resource Quality.

On mobile devices, every switch between packages requires downloading the difference between the HD and SD packages.

Test Schedule

  • Test Participants and Test Schedule

  • PC (※Official Launcher): The test will become gradually available on PC after the Version 3.7 update.

  • iOS/Android Mobile: The test will become available on all iOS/Android mobile devices after the Version 3.7 update.

  • Notes

  • We will soon (during Version 3.6) make a PC launcher update available to some of the Rovers who are granted access to the limited test. However, the "Tiered Client Resource Downloads" feature will only go live after the Version 3.7 update. During Version 3.6, being granted access to the limited test will not affect your current gaming experience.

  • Following the Version 3.7 update, PC users who have not been granted access to the limited test will have their resource package updated to the High-Definition (HD) version by default. Once you enter the test, you can adjust the resource tier based on your needs.

The feature will also be gradually made available on PC platforms with non-official launchers after the test concludes. Please stay tuned for future announcements.

Notes & Reminders

About Version 3.7 Pre-download

  • PC (※Official Launcher):

  • For Rovers who are granted access to the limited test and update the official launcher during Version 3.6, Version 3.7 pre-download will be temporarily unavailable due to cross-version functionality differences. You may select and download a suitable resource tier after the Version 3.7 update.

  • For Rovers who do not gain access to the limited test during Version 3.6, pre-download will remain available, and if they use the pre-download feature, the HD resource tier will be downloaded by default. After gaining test access in Version 3.7, you can then choose a resource tier based on your needs.

  • iOS/Android Mobile:

  • Once Version 3.7 pre-download becomes available, only a portion of the resources will be pre-downloaded on iOS and Android mobile devices. The remaining tiered resources will be downloaded separately after the Version 3.7 update, based on the package selected.

The Pre-download feature from Version 3.7 onward will function as usual, and the pre-downloaded resources will be of the same tier as your currently selected resources.

How to Choose a Package Tier

After the Version 3.7 update, if you have been included in the limited test, the recommended package will be marked on your device based on the device specifications. Alternatively, you can refer to the following specs table to select the right package.

  • PC

| | | | | |

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

| CPU | GPU | Recommended RAM | Recommended Resolution | Recommended Package |

| Intel i7-12700/AMD R7 7700 | RTX4080/RX 7900 XT | 32G | 3840X2160 | UHD |

| Intel i7-9700/AMD R7 3700X | RTX3060/RX6700XT/Arc B580 | 32G | 2560X1440 | HD |

| Intel i5-9400/AMD R7 2700 | GTX 1060/RX 570/Arc A380 | 16G | 1920X1080 | SD |

  • iOS

| | | | |

| --- | --- | --- | --- |

| Model | Chip | RAM | Recommended Package |

| iPhone14/iPad mini (6th generation) | A15 | 6G | HD |

| iPhone11/iPad (9th generation) | A13 | 4G | SD |

  • Android

| | | |

| --- | --- | --- |

| Chipset | RAM | Recommended Package |

| Snapdragon 8 Gen1/MediaTek Dimensity 9000/Kirin 9010/Exynos 2200 | 8G | HD |

| Snapdragon 855/MediaTek Dimensity 1000/Kirin 980/Exynos 9820 | 6G | SD |

About In-Game Resource Adjustments

  • Graphics Resource Adjustments

After the release of the "Tiered Client Resource Downloads" feature, the Ultra Quality option in the in-game Graphics Quality settings will be available only in the UHD package. Therefore, after Version 3.7 goes live, if you are not in the limited test, you will temporarily be unable to enable the Ultra Graphics option on PC. To enable this option, you need to download the UHD package first after entering the test.

  • Video Resource Adjustments

After the release of the "Tiered Client Resource Downloads" feature, bitrates of certain cutscenes and other video assets will be adjusted accordingly; consequently, visual fidelity may differ between packages.

Following the Version 3.7 update, because PC users who have not been granted access to the limited test will download the HD package by default, the visual performance of certain video resources may be somewhat different from the previous versions. When you are granted test access, you can download the UHD package for higher bitrates.

  • Future Resource Adjustments

The upcoming "Tiered Client Resource Downloads" feature is currently under continuous optimization. In the future, we may adjust the resources included in each tier based on in-game performance and player feedback. The adjusted resources may differ slightly from those in the current test version. Announcements about adjustments in this regard will be made during the corresponding versions. Please stay tuned.

About Release Schedule on PC Platforms Using Non-official Launchers

  • Steam

To bring the "Tiered Client Resource Downloads" feature to Steam, we plan to release the official launcher on this platform in the future. When the Official Launcher becomes available on Steam, the platform will also support pre-download for the game. Please remember to update your launcher and experience the new features. These features are currently under active development and will be made available as soon as possible. We will notify you of the release schedule and detailed instructions on how to update the launcher in future announcements. Please stay tuned.

FAQ

Q: Are package tiers the same as in-game graphics settings?

A: No, they are different. The package tier determines the upper limit of the quality of the downloaded resources, such as image clarity and video bitrate, while in-game graphics settings remain adjustable. However, visual performance and resolution will vary from tier to tier even with the same graphics settings. For example, with the High Quality option enabled, the UHD package delivers higher image clarity and shows more details than the HD package.

Q: What are the differences between the various package tiers?

A: The package tiers vary in package size, video bitrate, and highest available resolution. For instance, the differences between the available tiers in Version 3.7 are as follows:

| | | | | | |

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

| Platform | Package Tier | Size (excluding cutscenes) | Size (including cutscenes) | Recommended Resolution | Highest Available Graphics Quality |

| PC | UHD | 99G | 128G | 3840X2160 | Ultra Quality |

| HD | 80G | 97G | 2560X1440 | High Quality |

| SD | 58G | 70G | 1920X1080 | Balanced |

| iOS / Android | HD | 40G | 53G | / | High Quality |

| SD | 35G | 43G | / | Balanced |

Package sizes shown are estimates. Please refer to the actual sizes in Version 3.7.

Q: How do I know which package to choose?

A: If you have been included in the limited test, the recommended package will be marked on your device based on the device specifications. Alternatively, you can refer to the specs table listed in the "How to Choose a Package Tier" section.

Q: Can I download a tier higher than what is recommended?

A: Yes. The recommendation is made based on your device specifications. You are free to download any tier you prefer. However, downloading a tier higher than recommended will take up unnecessary storage space and could cause framerate fluctuations, device overheating, and other issues. Please adjust accordingly based on your experience.

Due to hardware limitations, only the SD package is available on certain iOS/Android devices, in order to ensure a stable, smooth gaming experience.

Q: How many packages can I install locally?

A: Up to 3 different package tiers can be installed locally at the same time on PC; there is no need to uninstall existing tiers before downloading new ones. Only 1 package tier can be installed locally at the same time on mobile devices, and every switch between packages requires downloading the difference between the packages.

Q: If I'm in the limited test, can I exit it and pre-download Version 3.7?

A: Unfortunately, once you enter the test during Version 3.6, you cannot exit it. You may select and download a suitable resource tier after the Version 3.7 update. Thank you for your support and understanding.

Q: Will my access to the pre-download option be affected if I'm not in the limited test?

A: No. If you're not in the limited test, you can pre-download as normal, but the HD package will be pre-downloaded by default. For more details, please refer to the "About Version 3.7 Pre-download" section above.

Q: Can I participate in the test if I'm not using the official launcher on PC?

A: The test is currently available only on PC devices using the official launcher. Access to this feature will be gradually opened to other PC platforms with non-official launchers once the test concludes. For details, please refer to the "About Release Schedule on PC Platforms Using Non-official Launchers" section.

Q: Will the resources of each tier change in the future?

A: The upcoming "Tiered Client Resource Downloads" feature is currently under continuous optimization. In the future, we may adjust the resources included in each tier based on in-game performance and player feedback. The adjusted resources may differ to some extent from those in the current test version. Announcements about adjustments in this regard will be made during the corresponding versions. Please stay tuned.

We will continue to refine the "Tiered Client Resource Downloads" feature based on player feedback. If you encounter any issues or have any suggestions, please access the in-game [Feedback] feature to submit your feedback. Thank you for your support and understanding.

Wuthering Waves Dev Team

[Thousand Futures Mirrored in Snow] Featured Resonator Convene

During the event, 5-Star Resonator: Hiyuki, 4-Star Resonators: Mortefi, Aalto, Yuanwu receive boosted drop rates!

Duration

2026-09-10 10:00 - 2026-09-29 11:59 (server time)

Eligibility

  • Reach Union Level 5.

  • Or complete the combat trial in First Resonance.

  • Or access Main Quest Fast Track Event and proceed with the Main Quest until you reach a certain point.

Convene Rules

  • [Thousand Futures Mirrored in Snow] is a Featured Resonator Convene event banner. Use Radiant Tide to convene. You are guaranteed at least one 4-Star or higher rarity Resonator or Weapon every 10 attempts.

  • The guarantee count is shared among all Featured Resonator Convene events and is carried over until a 5-Star Resonator is obtained.

  • Featured Resonator Hiyuki is exclusive to the [Thousand Futures Mirrored in Snow] Featured Resonator Convene and will not be available by other means once the event ends.

  • Featured Resonator Hiyuki's Waveband will be simultaneously made available in the Afterglow Coral Store with a limit of 2 purchases, and it will be removed once the Convene event ends.

  • During the event, all the Resonators who receive boosted drop rates will become available in Ascendant Aces as Trial Resonators. Complete their Ascendant Aces challenges to obtain rewards.

For more details, please refer to the in-game Convene page.
